policy.source_policy: Snowflake-owned exam guides, documentation, product docs, verified Snowflake credential metadata, and Snowflake training pages only for factual grounding. No exam dumps or recalled live questions.
policy.retirement_policy: Retiring exams remain in the corpus until retirement, are clearly flagged, and are retained afterward as archived banks for historical learners unless replaced by a successor blueprint.

certifications.name: SnowPro Associate: Platform
objectives: Set up and navigate the Snowflake user interface and Snowflake Notebooks
Create databases and stages, and use compute resources
Load and leverage structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data
Understand Snowflake roles and data access management
Understand and manage the Snowflake account structure
Call Snowflake Cortex LLM functions

certifications.name: SnowPro Core
objectives: Use the Snowflake AI Data Cloud architecture
Manage Snowflake accounts and virtual warehouses
Perform data loading, unloading, and transformation
Use structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data
Monitor and optimize performance
Enable data collaboration and protection
Establish Snowflake connectivity

certifications.name: SnowPro Specialty: Gen AI
objectives: Define and implement Snowflake Gen AI principles, capabilities, and best practices
Use Snowflake Cortex AI features and functions, including LLMs, to meet customer use cases
Build and fine-tune open-source models with Snowpark Container Services and Snowflake Model Registry
Use Snowflake document processing functions to build, manage, and optimize document parsing pipelines

certifications.name: SnowPro Specialty: Snowpark
objectives: Perform data transformations using Snowpark DataFrame functions
Query data sources as Snowpark DataFrame objects
Connect to Snowflake using a Snowpark session object
Process results client-side or persist results in Snowflake through Snowpark DataFrame actions
Design a sequence of operations or conditional logic with Snowpark stored procedures

certifications.name: SnowPro Specialty: Native Apps
objectives: Design Native App architectures based on business and technical requirements
Build Native App components including manifests, setup scripts, and application logic
Deploy apps to Snowflake Marketplace and support installation and troubleshooting
Manage version release workflows, release management privileges, and application upgrades

certifications.name: SnowPro Advanced: MLOps Engineer
objectives: Operationalize, scale, and automate machine learning workflows within the Snowflake AI Data Cloud
Architect and manage ML infrastructure, including feature engineering, model training, and deployment pipelines
Deploy, monitor, and govern ML models across production environments using Snowflake-native capabilities
Implement CI/CD and pipeline orchestration to automate end-to-end ML lifecycle management
Apply governance, security, and cost management practices throughout ML workflows

certifications.name: SnowPro Advanced: Security Engineer
objectives: Design and enforce data protection, privacy, and governance across Snowflake
Implement and manage user identity and access control mechanisms
Audit and monitor security policies, controls, and regulatory compliance requirements
Assess threats and risks, and execute robust security incident response protocols
Leverage Snowflake AI/ML capabilities to enhance security posture

certifications.name: SnowPro Advanced: Architect
objectives: Design an end-to-end data flow from source to consumption using the Snowflake Platform
Design and deploy a data architecture that meets business, security, and compliance requirements
Select appropriate Snowflake and third-party tools to optimize architecture performance
Design and deploy a shared data set using the Snowflake Marketplace and Data Exchange

certifications.name: SnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer
objectives: Source data from Data Lakes, APIs, and on-premises
Transform, replicate, and share data across cloud platforms
Design end-to-end near real-time streams
Design scalable compute solutions for Data Engineer workloads
Evaluate performance metrics

certifications.name: SnowPro Advanced: Data Scientist
objectives: Outline data science concepts
Implement Snowflake data science best practices
Prepare data and use feature engineering in Snowflake
Train and use machine learning models
Use GenAI and LLM capabilities in Snowflake

certifications.name: SnowPro Advanced: Administrator
objectives: Manage and administer Snowflake accounts, data security, and governance
Manage and maintain database objects and virtual warehouses
Perform database monitoring, tuning, and optimization
Perform data sharing and use the Snowflake Marketplace
Implement disaster recovery, perform backups, and replicate data

certifications.name: SnowPro Advanced: Data Analyst
objectives: Prepare and load data
Perform simple data transformations for data analysis
Build and troubleshoot advanced SQL queries in Snowflake
Use Snowflake built-in functions and create User-Defined Functions (UDFs)
Perform descriptive and diagnostic data analyses
Perform predictive data analysis
Prepare and present data to meet business requirements
